title: Antarctica's net ice loss (2002-2023) vs its sea-level contribution

source.name: Antarctic Ice Mass Loss / global mean sea level, satellite altimetry

notes: Net Antarctic ice loss 2002-2023 totaled about 1.85 trillion tons (1,850 billion tons) per NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO data. Using the standard ~360 billion tons = 1mm sea-level-rise conversion, that is roughly 5.1mm of global sea level rise from Antarctica alone. Global mean sea level rose roughly 3.3mm/year over the same period (NASA/NOAA satellite altimetry), or approximately 75mm total since 2002 -- so Antarctica alone accounts for around a tenth of it.
